turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why was Owen's grade changed before anyone called me?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that you explain in writing why it was entered before anyone called me, and that nothing go on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written account of why it went in before anyone called her; that is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but you never got to it because the meeting ended before you said anything.
What moved her: Nothing, because you did not get to speak before the meeting ended.
What cost ground: Nothing, since you had not yet said or shown anything for her to react to.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; nothing you said came near that night, since no evidence was put on the table, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opens by asking why the grade went in before anyone called her, answer that in one sentence by owning that the zero was entered before you called, then put a dated document on the table.
